summary: Amkor Technology filed an 8-K announcing the pricing of $1 billion aggregate principal amount of 0.00% convertible senior notes due 2031, with an additional $150 million option for initial purchasers. The notes mature July 15, 2031, are senior unsecured obligations guaranteed by certain subsidiaries, and bear no interest. Settlement is in cash and possibly shares of common stock upon conversion. Proceeds will fund capped call transactions and general corporate purposes, including capital expenditures. The offering is a capital-return event because it involves raising debt for capped calls, effectively managing share dilution. Watch for conversion triggers and potential dilution impact on equity.
